messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING @oncall: High KV cache eviction rate + continuous-batching drop observed for hosted/text-generation. Alert: sustained evictions/sec > 40k, batch fragmentation up, tool/function-calls spiking. Please ack and follow playbook 3.
Alyssa G: acked. jumping in. any service impact visible to customers?
Kei N: seeing p95 latency climb across api-prod-route/toolcall -> 120ms -> 2.8s, error rate increased from 0.05% -> 2.3% in last 10m. Requests with structured tool outputs show near 100% cache miss.
Rami K: noted. looks like structured outputs include ever-changing metadata (request_id / txn_id) which is included in the cache key by the prefetcher. That will fragment the KV indices and blow up memory.
Maria S: Confirmed reproducer in staging: run the toolcall smoke with structured_response=true and you'll see kv-cache keys explode. Logs: 
```
evictions/sec: 45234
kv_store.size: 12.4GB -> 42.1GB
continuous_batch.size.avg: 1.2 -> 0.18
worker_queue_latency: p95 320ms -> 1.9s
error: batch-broken: toolcall-structured-output-length > 0
```
Alyssa G: immediate mitigations we should consider (priority):
  1) disable structured prefetch for toolcall routes (fastest)
  2) temporarily tighten batching (max_batch_tokens=512) or set max_batch=1 for problematic routes
  3) enable aggressive TTLs / LRU trim on kv-cache and lower min_cache_reuse_threshold
Which one can we push now?
Rami K: I can flip the route flag to disable prefetch for toolcall routes. CLI: `rwctl routes update --route toolcall --prefetch false --force`
Kei N: I can also push a safe config to the autoscaler to lower burst capacity so we don't amplify thrash.
ops-bot: rolling change: routes/toolcall prefetched=false by Alyssa G (deploy id: dpl-8791)
Alyssa G: pushed the prefetch disable. monitoring now.
Maria S: after change: evictions/sec -> 3.2k, kv_store.size plateaued and starting to fall, continuous_batch avg size rising back to ~0.9. latency improved to p95 ~480ms. Error rate down to 0.6%.
eng-qa: ran synthetic against top-customer workload (AcmeCorp) -- toolcall path results: success rate restored to 99.1% within 7m of hotfix. Good sign.
Rami K: follow-up: this is root cause pattern: structured outputs (freeform JSON with varying metadata keys) were included verbatim in the KV cache key. Prefetcher attempted to cache responses per full output prefix; for tool/function calls that include unique ids this yields near-zero cache hits and O(N) new keys per request.
Kei N: propose long-term fixes:
  - strip stable-only fields from cache key (hash only canonicalized parts)
  - add max-key-length cap and prefix-hash windowing
  - prefer prefix-canonicalization for structured outputs before prefetch cache writes
  - add a safety circuit: if eviction rate > X -> auto-disable prefetch for that route
Alyssa G: agreed. I'll create a follow-up ticket and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml to design canonicalization and safety circuit. Ticket: RD-INC-1795.
Maria S: customer impact summary for ops: top 3 impacted customers: AcmeCorp (5% of production traffic) saw requests p95 spikes and some soft-failures, BetaApps saw degraded latency, internal canaries tripped. We should notify SOC and account teams.
Rami K: handoff note: I'm offshift in 40m. Alyssa, can you take lead for the immediate postmortem? I'll pair with you on docs then hand off to oncall tomorrow.
Alyssa G: will do. Rami, can you drop the debug steps you ran so we can capture for incident writeup?
Rami K: gist of commands and queries I used:
```
# show top eviction keys
redis-cli --scan | grep toolcall | xargs -n1 redis-cli TTL
# route config
rwctl routes get --route toolcall --output json
# disable prefetch
rwctl routes update --route toolcall --prefetch false --force
# monitor
promql: rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])
```
Maria S: ops note: we also temporarily bumped the memtrim threshold to 60% to force more aggressive LRU trimming while we stabilize.
ops-bot: memtrim threshold updated to 60% for cluster=prod (change id: cfg-4492)
Alyssa G: Postmortem actions (short-term):
  - ship prefetch-safety circuit (eng-runtime)
  - add canonicalization whitelist/blacklist for cache keys (eng-ml + runtime)
  - add observability: per-route cache fragmentation metric (eng-platform)
  - customer outreach: SRE -> SOC -> Account teams (ops)
I'll own coordinating the tickets.
Kei N: scheduling: I'll keep autoscaler config conservative for the next 24h. If we see another spike, we'll revert to per-route max_batch=1.
Rami K: handing off: added notes to RD-INC-1795 and added me as fallback. Leaving channel but monitoring on pager.
Alyssa G: thanks, handing off to me. I'll update the incident channel with timeline and assign owners.
eng-qa: quick note: add a regression test that simulates structured tool output with unique metadata keys to ensure cache-key canonicalization doesn't regress.
Maria S: I'll prepare the customer impact email draft for the account teams (ETA 2h).
Alyssa G: closing the immediate page. If anything degrades, re-open with :rotating_light:. Great job everyone. :thumbsup:
